notes.title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition is out now!
notes.content:
Greetings Mighty Warriors of Ashan! 

We’re glad to announce that Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition is available on PC starting today with a 15% launch discount for everyone and an additional 40% discount for original owners. Please note that both discounts will be available for two weeks only.  

Play Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213300/Might__Magic_Clash_of_Heroes__Definitive_Edition/ 

If you’ve never played Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes before, here’s a small introduction to this incredible gem from the past. 

Anwen, Godric, Fiona, Aidan, and Nadia are five mighty heroes scattered around five different regions of Ashan. After the rise of the demons, these heroes battle their way through their respective kingdoms to unravel the mysteries behind the chaos threatening their world. 

How to play Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definite Edition? 

The game is a puzzle RPG game with unique and deep gameplay mechanics that makes it fun to play and quickly addictive. We recently released a gameplay trailer that teaches you everything you need to know to begin your incredible journey through the lands of Ashan. 

[previewyoutube=baXocheKqP0;full][/previewyoutube]

As a result, all you need to do to play and defeat unit enemies is to match three units of the same type and color vertically to create an attack. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/fee7ab079236754a121a0c28b69be8861449f7cf.gif

Matching three or more units of the same color horizontally will build a defensive wall. You can also reinforce them by building additional walls. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/18cb3cfcccecd9a19b7e5bece25b7b0165f3a8b3.gif

Catch intel about Factions, units, and gameplay mechanics with our Gameplay Introduction Blogpost: https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692432394700854281?snr=1_2108_9__2107 

Add Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition to your Wishlist:

notes.title: Gameplay Introduction to Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.content:
Greetings Mighty Heroes!

Today we want to give you a quick gameplay introduction to Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/e1e34841552aeaa62cccde7ecac0e5782ecde656.png

Take control of your hero’s units on the battlefield and maneuver them to create impenetrable defenses or devastating attacks!

Match three units of the same type and color vertically to create an attack formation:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/9eca5d169655da256886c7215b468a2bc18cd28e.gif

Notice the blue number appearing on top of the formation? This indicates the number of turns until the attack is charged. Once that number falls to zero, the units will unleash their attack:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/d6449b7891482ffa6e7a427d634ed4ba73d1dcbe.gif

Match three or more units of the same color horizontally to form a defensive wall:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/7613e3b6c65d511614ea07119b86e6a47b72d752.gif

These walls form immediately and can be reinforced by building additional walls behind them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/8dbc9962e5b1221126062712f453bbaaba1bac47.gif

Each unit you unlock during the game will have unique stats:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/a0f43b8d3ccd14954ccedac87ab59f1b5a76bbcd.png
It is essential to understand each one to maximize your chances of winning:

 XP: This bar will fill up as you defeat enemies. Once it is full your unit will level up.
 LVL: This determines your unit's overall stats. As this goes up, your unit will become stronger.
 Sword Icon: This is your unit's PWR level. This indicates how much damage the unit's attack will deal after it is charged. This damage will be spread out across all the enemies the attack formation will face. 
Important: A unit's PWR level not only indicates its damage but also its defense. Therefore, a unit can withstand as high of an attack as it can deal.
 Hourglass Icon: This represents your unit's charging time. It shows how many turns it takes for its attack to charge.
 Heart icon: This represents how much damage your unit can withstand when it is idle (not in an attack formation).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/9922a90d2ad08c6bcdf36777c32fd33085a22a4c.png

Factions determine which specific set of units are available to equip in battle. For example, the Sylvan Faction is composed of woodland creatures, whereas the Inferno Faction is made up of demonic creatures. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/e75f318abe5727a23a805e7581312a9f3ee16347.gif

Each faction also offers a unique wall ability: one can repair walls over time, while another can make walls burn enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/fc45edae95271320ff8e8d1caf0c30da207859c5.png

Elite and Champion units are pivotal resources in a battle. Their attacks take longer to charge and are harder to activate, but are more powerful and can be devastating finishers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/def3f6b317d13dc2e453b334e914d5845f559f28.gif

Contrary to ordinary “core” units, Elite and Champion units are limited in number, therefore you will have to buy them again if they fall in battle. Use them wisely!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/50a182ce2461516e8de63d9bc30181a37a2b7cc6.png

Each hero possesses a unique spell that can be activated when their spell meter is full.

The spell meter replenishes itself every time you inflict or receive damage and create formations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/8de5d2359b4586e204195b49461363d4ac6d3bbf.gif

From shooting giant arrows to summoning lightning bolts, each hero’s unique spell can be the difference between defeat and victory!

This was just an introduction to MM:COH - DE’s gameplay. There are many more mechanics we have yet to cover, as well as advanced gameplay strategies! Stay tuned for more content like this and don't forget to:

notes.title: The World and Characters of Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.content:
Welcome Mighty Heroes!

While the game has not yet launched, we wanted to take this opportunity to offer a small guide to its world and characters, especially for those unfamiliar with the Might & Magic franchise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/ef4a766b3fa04f3f2fafc26fb69d714a2bf52f1d.png

Shattered by the never-ending struggle between Order and Chaos, Ashan is the world of Might and Magic. It is comprised of many realms, of which you will explore four in MM: COH:

IrollanA lush magical forest guarded by Elves 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/a30b4a7ba839c419d16ffbdaafed069401f56ce8.gif

The Holy Griffin EmpireA vast human empire ruled by Knights

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/0f3467bb284f9536e81846d1e6feb542de477b1a.gif

HereshA barren wasteland ruled by Necromancers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/e8c05f472d2295fbc116093d8f79a91aa72c2558.gif

The Silver CitiesA desert kingdom ruled by Wizards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/2cfeee9389770dc6776288d71e1e98ada9aac130.gif

SheoghThe underground prison realm of Demons 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/f5351083b8699e1aa3706ffe38dc23a0c3a04d82.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/3a4dd1fe281d55a62f81ec508d55e1a2c1e39013.png

Demons have long been at war with the inhabitants of Ashan.

Blood moons weakened the walls of their prison, letting them escape and lay waste to anything they could.

During the last Demon War, The Blade of Binding was created. A powerful artifact that could bend any Demon to its wielder’s will. 

The Blade is now protected by a handful of allies in Ashan, but dark forces coveting its power are on the move… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/ff5a5d44af19e62a9b4aeca1a399d31d0a1970b6.png

While MM: COH is full of characters, we will focus on the five main playable characters today
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/9fe532f6573a8599535fba3c5208fe1ce74f9583.png
An elf from the Irollan forest and the daughter of a ranger. She commands Sylvan Faction units (Pixies, Bears, Druids…)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/44491cf1c0e48f340034b061a63159deabe73877.pngThe eldest son of the Unicorn Duchy of the Holy Griffin Empire. A promising knight who commands Haven Faction units (Swordsmen, Knights, Priestesses…)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/c8895de1186b5bebbf1b7c246cd9dff245cb1aab.pngGodric’s younger sister. She rises from the dead as a ghost and necromancer. She commands Necropolis Faction units (Skeletons, Vampires, Ghosts…)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/c039233cfb333600b074ec72764e1e42cb51901f.pngThe youngest of the Unicorn siblings. He finds himself trapped in Sheogh, the realm of Demons, and discovers a mysterious blade allowing him to control Inferno Faction units (Hellhounds, Succubi, Imps…)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/7f407b80911501175d44b571869b6d1de0232b88.pngThe daughter of a respected Mage of the Silver Cities, she is a wizard who controls Academy Faction Units (Mages, Djinns, Golems…)

We'll explore each character's unique abilities and gameplay tips and tricks in upcoming posts!
Thank you again for your interest in the game and don't forget to:
